fix.summary: Add trust annotations to WebMCP tools and keep secrets out of tool definitions.

checkpoints.why: Tool definitions are visible to AI agents and may be cached or logged. Explicit trust metadata, bounded origin exposure, and lifecycle cancellation help agents invoke tools safely.

nl.name: Veiligheid van tooldefinities
steps: Voeg de annotaties readOnlyHint en untrustedContentHint toe aan elke tool.
Verwijder tokens, interne URL's en persoonsgegevens uit toolnamen en beschrijvingen.
Geef een AbortSignal mee, zodat de pagina tools kan afmelden.
nl.why: Tooldefinities zijn zichtbaar voor AI-agents en kunnen worden opgeslagen of gelogd. Expliciete vertrouwensmetadata, beperkte origin-blootstelling en annulering helpen agents om tools veilig te gebruiken.
nl.fix_summary: Voeg vertrouwensannotaties toe aan WebMCP-tools en houd geheimen uit tooldefinities.

checkpoints.name: Auto-submit risk

steps.action: Find forms with toolautosubmit and a password, payment or delete action.
Remove toolautosubmit from these forms so that the user confirms each submit.

fix.summary: Remove toolautosubmit from forms with sensitive data.

checkpoints.why: The toolautosubmit attribute allows AI agents to submit forms without user confirmation. This is safe for search/filter forms but risky for payment, account deletion, or password forms.

nl.name: Risico van automatisch verzenden
steps: Zoek formulieren met toolautosubmit en een wachtwoord-, betaal- of verwijderactie.
Verwijder toolautosubmit van deze formulieren, zodat de gebruiker elke verzending bevestigt.
nl.why: Het toolautosubmit-attribuut laat AI-agents formulieren verzenden zonder bevestiging. Dat is veilig voor zoek- en filterformulieren, maar riskant voor betalingen, accountverwijdering of wachtwoorden.
nl.fix_summary: Verwijder toolautosubmit van formulieren met gevoelige data.

checkpoints.name: OAuth discovery

steps.action: Serve the RFC 8414 metadata with issuer, authorization_endpoint and token_endpoint.

fix.summary: Publish OAuth authorization server metadata at /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server.

checkpoints.why: OAuth and OIDC discovery (RFC 8414, OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0) let agents authenticate with your APIs without manual setup.

nl.name: OAuth-discovery
steps: Lever de RFC 8414-metadata met issuer, authorization_endpoint en token_endpoint.
nl.why: OAuth- en OIDC-discovery (RFC 8414, OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0) laten agents bij je API's authenticeren zonder handmatige setup.
nl.fix_summary: Publiceer OAuth-metadata van de autorisatieserver op /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server.

checkpoints.name: OAuth protected resource

steps.action: Serve the RFC 9728 metadata.
Return WWW-Authenticate with resource_metadata on 401 responses.

fix.summary: Publish /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource with the resource and its authorization servers.

checkpoints.why: OAuth Protected Resource Metadata (RFC 9728) tells agents which authorization servers issue tokens for your APIs.

nl.name: OAuth protected resource
steps: Lever de RFC 9728-metadata.
Geef WWW-Authenticate met resource_metadata terug op 401-responses.
nl.why: OAuth Protected Resource Metadata (RFC 9728) vertelt agents welke autorisatieservers tokens voor je API's uitgeven.
nl.fix_summary: Publiceer /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource met de resource en de autorisatieservers.

checkpoints.name: Agent auth readiness

verify.expect: The documentation explains self-serve API-key creation and named scopes, or an OAuth flow with discoverable metadata, PKCE S256 and scopes. This check does not attempt authentication.

steps.action: For API keys, explain where to create a key without manual approval and name the available scopes. For OAuth, publish the authorization server and protected resource metadata.
Explain what each scope permits. For OAuth, list scopes_supported and include S256 in code_challenge_methods_supported.
Publish /auth.md with the credential setup, narrowest usable scope and an authenticated request example for the supported flow.
steps.code_example:
# Authentication for agents

Create an API key in the [dashboard](https://example.com/settings/api-keys) without manual approval.

## Scopes
- `catalog:read`: Read the catalog. Select this scope for catalog queries.

Send the key in the Authorization header as a bearer token.

Example: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://example.com/api/catalog`

fix.summary: Document a scoped API-key flow or an OAuth flow with discovery metadata and PKCE S256.

checkpoints.expected: A documented self-serve API-key flow with named scopes, or discoverable OAuth metadata with PKCE S256, scopes and an authentication walkthrough.
checkpoints.why: Agents need a documented way to obtain credentials with permissions suited to the task. Self-serve scoped API keys or delegated OAuth with discovery metadata and PKCE can provide that path. Documentation does not verify that authentication succeeds.

nl.name: Auth-gereedheid voor agents
steps: Leg bij API-sleutels uit waar je zonder handmatige goedkeuring een sleutel aanmaakt en benoem de beschikbare scopes. Publiceer bij OAuth de metadata van de autorisatieserver en de beschermde resource.
